logic.note: Regulating, dropout and off states; the AP2112 EN pin switches it.

timing.note: Settles instantly with each re-solve: no start-up time, no line or load transients, no capacitors.

analog.note: Output 3.3 V with 0.05 Ω output resistance; in dropout VOUT = VIN − the full-load dropout (0.178 V MCP1700, 0.25 V AP2112), which overstates the drop at light load. Input current = output current + quiescent current.

power.note: Warns above the rated output current, above 6 V in, and when (VIN − VOUT) × I passes 0.3 W (small package). No current limit or thermal shutdown: the output stays up.

emulates: 3.3 V from a LiPo, USB or AA cells
doesNotEmulate: Load and line transients (needs its 1 µF capacitors in real life)
Dropout that shrinks at light load
testOnRealDevice: The 3.3 V rail at your lowest battery voltage
Stability with your capacitors (MCP1700 is happy with 1 µF ceramic)
